en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside promenade and steamboat landing on the Elbe River. On the left, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along a path lined with trees and buildings. On the right, several paddle steamers and small boats are moored at a landing stage in front of a multi‑arched brick bridge crossing the river. The scene is calm and picturesque, with a lightly clouded sky above.
